title: Copa del Rey, first round (rescheduled ties)
updateNote: The first day after the international window, with no top-flight league games in Europe. Six Copa del Rey first-round ties that were postponed twice (after the Toledo rail crash on 28 Oct and the death of Tenerife's Jesús de Miguel) are played tonight, Mallorca's trip to Alcoyano the pick of them. Plus Coritiba v Santos in the Brasileirão (23:30) and Alianza Atlético v Melgar in Peru. KickOff has no bet365 prices for the cup ties or the Peru game, so those ladders come from other named bookmakers (each odds note says which, and what is missing); Coritiba v Santos is priced from bet365. Team sheets for the cup ties are pending and the kick-off-minus-40 runs fill them in. Brazil's later games (Cruzeiro v Palmeiras, Flamengo v Athletico-PR and others) kick off after midnight here and belong to 19 Nov; the Women's Champions League games are left off.

Its RFEF notice of 5 November set the new date: Wednesday 18 November, 19:00 peninsular time. Portugalete are 4th in Segunda Federación Group 1 (W5 D4 L2, 19-13, 19 points) and unbeaten in five league games (W2 D3, 12-6). Recent meetings: a 1-1 friendly at Irun on 9 August 2025, Portugalete 2-0 Real Unión on 21 March 2021 and Real Unión 2-1 Portugalete on 20 December 2020.

matches.context: This is a one-off first-round Copa del Rey tie at El Collao, kicking off at 20:00 Madrid time (19:00 UTC). It was first set for 28 October, but the RFEF suspended it on the day after the train accident in Toledo, when Mallorca were already at their hotel. It was then moved to 5 November at 21:00 and postponed a second time. Mallorca play in Segunda División this season and are 7th, a point behind Burgos in the last play-off place. They are six league games unbeaten and drew 3-3 with Córdoba on 14 November, with two goals from Sergi Darder and one from Adam Buksa. Alcoyano are two levels lower, 7th of 18 in Segunda Federación Group 3 with 17 points from 11 games (W5 D2 L4, goals 16-15). They beat Intercity 4-1 on 15 November and have scored four goals in two of their last three league games, and in October they won 1-0 at Mallorca B. Mallorca are expected to rotate heavily and fill the squad with reserve-team players, as they did against Córdoba. If the score is level after 90 minutes the tie goes to extra time and penalties, and all prices here are for 90 minutes. In past meetings, Alcoyano knocked a top-flight Mallorca out of the cup 4-1 in October 2005, and Mallorca won both Segunda B games in 2017/18.

news.text: Tenerife forward Jesús de Miguel, 30, died on 3 November after a 97th-minute collision with Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono in a league game at the Heliodoro Rodríguez López. Before the original 28 October date he was named among the players due to get minutes in this tie.

For the original 28 October date, Cervera left Enric Gallego, Nacho Gil, David Rodríguez and Landázuri in Tenerife. He said he would make changes but wanted to go through. Gabri de Vuyst was expected in goal, with minutes for Mateu, Pecar and Ranos, and B-team players Oier Gastesi and Omar Sánchez travelled. No squad list for 18 November was found.
Fabricio went off injured after 78 minutes in the 2-0 win over Ceuta on 15 November and was replaced by Juanjo.
Tenerife beat Ceuta 2-0 on 15 November (Nacho Gil 40', Neal Viereck 86' from a Nacho Gil corner) after league draws with Andorra (2-2), Sabadell (1-1) and Celta Fortuna (1-1).

Badajoz beat Don Benito 2-1 on 15 November (Nacho 11', G. Perero 59'), after 1-1 draws with Ciudad de Lucena and Linares. They are unbeaten in seven league games. Coach: Miguel Ángel Ávila. No injury or suspension news was found.

matches.context: This is matchday 17 of the Torneo Clausura, kicking off at 15:00 Lima time (20:00 UTC) in Sullana. Melgar are 5th in the Clausura on 29 points from 16 games (W8 D5 L3), one point ahead of 7th-placed Alianza Atlético on 28 (W9 D1 L6). Over the whole season (33 games) Melgar are 3rd on 57 points and Alianza 9th on 49. Alianza have lost three of their last five (scored 5, conceded 10): 1-4 at Sport Huancayo, 3-2 v Garcilaso, 1-0 v Juan Pablo II, 0-2 at FC Cajamarca, then 0-2 v Sporting Cristal on 15 November, a game footballpredictions.ai lists as Copa de la Liga. That leaves them three days' rest, while Melgar last played on 7 November. Melgar's last five read W L D W W (scored 9, conceded 7), most recently 2-1 v Juan Pablo II. Melgar won the last meeting 3-1 at home in Arequipa on 31 May and have won four of the last eight meetings to Alianza's two. The last two games in Sullana ended 0-0 (August 2025) and 3-1 to Alianza (July 2024). The 1X2 has moved toward Alianza: footballpredictions.ai shows 2.30 / 3.25 / 2.88, BC.Game 2.10 / 3.40 / 3.30 with the home price falling, and Betsson 1.92 / 3.70 / 4.00 on the evening of 17 November. No source found explains the move.

matches.context: Kick-off is 19:30 Brasília time (22:30 UTC), per the CBF referee listing and Revista Oeste. KickOff and statz.ai both give 22:30 UK time. Coritiba are 13th on 42 points after 34 games (W11 D9 L14, 40-51), five points clear of the relegation zone. They are under interim coach Guilherme Bossle after Fernando Seabra was sacked, and they have won one of their last nine league games (W1 D2 L6), most recently losing 1-0 at Internacional on 4 Nov. Santos (Cuca) are 9th on 47 points (W12 D11 L11, 50-49) and chasing a continental place: Sports Mole has them six points behind sixth-placed Bahia, and O Liberal (5 Nov) has them seven behind Athletico-PR. They have won one of their last six league games, the latest a 2-1 defeat at Red Bull Bragantino on 2 Nov. Coritiba won the reverse fixture 3-0 at Santos on 17 May (Breno Lopes 6' and 20', Josué penalty 39'; Barreal sent off on 73'). Santos had already knocked Coritiba out of the Copa do Brasil fifth round, 0-0 away and then 2-0 in Curitiba on 13 May. Neymar's two-game ban (a red card against Bahia under the 'Lei Vini Jr.') was cut to one game by the STJD and has already been served, so he is available.

referee.name: Bráulio da Silva Machado
referee.note: The CBF referee page (MASTER-PRO, from Tubarão, SC) lists him for this game, Série A Jogo 348, and statz.ai names him too. The figures come from his statz.ai profile, which covers 8 Campeonato Brasileiro games labelled 2025/26 and 2026/27. Its match table shows 31 yellows in the 8 Série A games of 2026. The fouls and red-card figures can't be checked against that table, which has no fouls or reds column. Foot Mercato's 2026 numbers are 39 yellows (3.9 a game) and 0 reds in 10 Série A games, and 117 yellows (4.5) and 0 reds in 26 games across all competitions. Its career line is 5.6 yellows and 0.13 reds a game over 264 games. Foot Mercato's 0 reds in 2026 conflicts with statz.ai's 1 red. He refereed Vasco 5-0 Coritiba on 19 Sep (3 yellows, statz.ai). CBF also lists him on Santos 0-3 Coritiba (17 May), but statz.ai names Paulo Cesar Zanovelli as that game's referee, so he was probably on the VAR team.

lineups.alt: The statz.ai preview article has Gonzalo Escobar instead of Willian Arão (Diógenes; Rodinei, Luan Peres, Escobar, João Alencar; Gustavo Henrique, Arthur Melo; Everton, Coutinho, Neymar; Gabriel Barbosa). It also lists the same Coritiba XI as a 4-2-3-1. Sports Mole (16 Nov) has Coritiba as Rangel; Tinga, Tiago Cóser, Moledo, Bruno Melo; Gómez, Thiago Santos; Lavega, Josué, Breno Lopes; Pedro Rocha, with Rodrigo Moledo for the doubtful Jacy and Joaquín Lavega for Fonseca. Its Santos XI is Diógenes; Rodinei, Arão, Luan Peres, Escobar; Gustavo Henrique, Oliva; Coutinho, Neymar, Everton; Gabriel Barbosa, with Christian Oliva for Arthur and no João Alencar.

news.text: Goalkeeper Pedro Morisco is away with the Brazil national team and is not expected back in time. Pedro Rangel (6 clean sheets this season, FotMob) starts.
Lucas Ronier (serious knee injury) remains out. He had 37 shots (2.06 a game) and 33 tackles this season.
Jacy hurt his knee against Internacional and was still in treatment, not yet back in full training. He is in the statz.ai predicted XI, while Sports Mole has Rodrigo Moledo in his place.
Guilherme Bossle is in interim charge after Fernando Seabra was sacked.
Neymar is available. The STJD cut his two-game ban for the red card against Bahia (Lei Vini Jr.) to one game, which he served in the 2-1 loss at Bragantino.
Goalkeeper Gabriel Brazão had left-shoulder surgery and should not play again this season.
Álvaro Barreal has a grade-3 right-thigh muscle injury and should miss the rest of the Brasileirão.
Centre-back Lucas Veríssimo has a thigh muscle injury and is due back only in the final rounds.
Vinícius Lira is still in physical transition after a serious left-knee injury.
Willian Arão (right thigh) has recovered and can return at centre-back. Gonzalo Escobar is cleared for left-back, and Thaciano is back training after an adductor problem.
Gabriel Bontempo (Brazil), Miguelito (Bolivia) and Gustavo Caballero (Paraguay) were with their national teams this window, and none is in any predicted XI.
Rony was due back in training on 16 Nov after leave following his father's death and could be available.
